checks.meaning: Apparent screening, reported receipt, prediction and legal entitlement remain separate.
Primary denominator is 1,013 people with resolved receipt; 67 report non-receipt; 187 unresolved adults remain outside it.
Person-weighted description remains distinct from unweighted model evaluation and invented demonstration rates.
Five predictor groups still supply six slopes; the seven-slope rural-formal attempt and category merge remain explained without theoretical equivalence.
Five folds hold whole households out, balance on household non-receipt, and fit missing-value rules inside training groups.
The 1,000 resamples use fixed predictions without fitting models or missing-value settings again.
AUC measures ranking, AP summarises precision over recall, and Brier measures squared probability error; no operational cutoff or accuracy claim is added.
Calibration intercept and slope retain ideal values zero and one and uncertainty caveats.
Odds and odds ratios remain separate from probabilities and causal effects.
S9 weighted fitting and S10 weighted evaluation remain distinct; neither becomes a full survey-design model.
Publisher donor-record imputation remains distinct from model missing-value treatment; screening and outcome values are not filled.
The app scores using the model trained on included adults, without retraining uploads; training overlap remains unknown.
Historical suite counts, original screening cases, software-path agreement and reload evidence retain their stated scope.
The owner walkthrough uses invented records, checks six extracted reports, and does not inspect the ZIP container.
No participant study, usability outcome, new province result, causal result or present-day entitlement claim is introduced.
The reported literature-search counts remain attributed to the proposal; publisher/legal authentication and ethics/disclosure limits are retained.

first_use_corrections: Replaced early undefined sensitivity analyses with alternative analyses before the later parenthetical definition.
Defined Streamlit as the Python framework used by the app, rather than defining the app as a framework.
Used predictor groups instead of introducing domains.

details_retained: Shared screening rules and rule/model versions
Historical CSV schema and study-context validation
Training-only missing-predictor settings and unscored-record policy
Saved non-executable JSON model and no upload retraining
Filtered views with unchanged full resolved-pass summary denominator
Generated row labels, protected exports and audit manifests
Correctness, repeatability and owner-workflow evidence with participant-testing limits
